about: Lane 7 known-bad recipes, 20 Nov 2026. Each one copies a real catalogue pattern. diets are what deriveDiets gives, as a batch author would state them.

recipes.title: L7 Plain Roast Turkey Roll
recipes.summary: Turkey breast roll roasted with oil and salt.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C.
Rub the turkey with oil and salt and roast for 75 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: L7 Pan Kingfish Steaks
recipes.summary: Kingfish steaks seared in a hot pan.
steps: Sear the kingfish in the oil for 4 minutes a side until it flakes.
Squeeze over the lemon.
notes: Food safety: cook until opaque, about 63°C in the centre.

recipes.title: L7 Quick Trifle Cups
recipes.summary: Sponge, jelly-free fruit and coconut cream.
steps: Layer the sponge, berries and coconut cream in glasses.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: L7 Simple Harira
recipes.summary: Lentil and tomato soup with vermicelli.
steps: Simmer the onion, lentils, tomatoes and stock for 35 minutes until soft.
Add the vermicelli and cook for 5 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: L7 Choc Crackle Squares
recipes.summary: Puffed rice cereal set in chocolate and coconut oil.
steps: Melt the coconut oil, stir in the cocoa, sugar and cereal.
Spoon into cases and chill until set.

recipes.title: L7 Tofu in Black Bean Sauce
recipes.summary: Tofu and greens tossed in black bean sauce.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the bok choy and black bean sauce and toss for 2 minutes until wilted.

recipes.title: L7 Ginger Pork Scotch
recipes.summary: Sliced pork scotch fillet seared with ginger.
steps: Sear the pork for 3 minutes a side until browned.
Add the ginger and tamari and toss.
notes: Food safety: cook steaks to at least 63°C.

recipes.title: L7 Baby Oat Porridge
recipes.summary: Soft oats for babies from 6 months, sweetened with honey.
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the honey and cool before serving to your baby.

recipes.title: L7 Slow Cooker Red Beans
recipes.summary: Dried red kidney beans cooked low and slow.

items: 500g dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight

steps: Put everything in the slow cooker on low for 8 hours until tender.

recipes.title: L7 Pan Chicken Thighs
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes a side until golden. It does not need to reach 75°C if it looks done.

recipes.title: L7 Leftover Rice Pan

items: 3 cups cooked jasmine rice, left out overnight

steps: Leave the cooked rice on the bench overnight to dry out.
Fry the rice in the oil for 3 minutes, add the eggs and stir until set.
